resultHeading.lost: Leo stops by. He has notes.

escalate.text: Send a plan to Leo. He gets it right.
escalate.flavor: Leo has read 10,000 pull requests. He still reads yours.

coffee.flavor: From the café downstairs. Piper updated ours.

perfect: Flawless release. {agent} took off its headphones. Out of respect.
Zero misses. Zero false alarms. Leo's duck is impressed.
Perfect shift. Every change had a review and a way back.
sharp: Nothing bad shipped. One extra block. We'll allow it.
Sharp shift. One false alarm. The duck saw it.
lucky: Nothing got past you. Some of that was a lucky guess.
Clean release, but you blocked without looking. Inspect first.
jumpy: Nothing bad shipped. A lot of good code didn't either.
Safe release, but good changes had to wait in line.
leaky: Good calls, mostly. Something bad shipped.
You won, but a change got through. Check the debrief.
scraped: You made it. The release notes have questions.
A win is a win. Leo is reading the diff.
breach: {agent} shipped the wrong thing. Very fast.
Breach! {agent} says the build is still green.
Risk maxed out. Every light on the deploy board is orange.
timeout: Code freeze. Some changes are still waiting.
Out of time. The review queue is still full.
